title: Fuel-cell slow-D twins on fresh seeds 12 and 13: ringless Df 0.2 matches the ringed world's division (25 vs 26 splits, gen 3 on 2/2); a new ringless twin with slow fuel only OUTSIDE the rods divides most (31, gen 3-4) with less interior fuel (0.50), so sealing the edge, not interior fuel, carries the effect, and no ring is needed
summary: Ran the finding's ringless twins (chi_s=0 with Df 0.5 or 0.2, everything else as c15's world.py) on fresh seeds 12 and 13, plus a twin the finding proposed: ringless with the fuel diffusivity lowered only outside the rods (world_outD.py: D = Df inside, Df_out=0.2 outside, smooth step tanh(phi/0.2)). Persistent splits seed 12/13 (generation; interior fuel by c15's ringstat.py): ringed world 16/10 (3/3; 0.56/0.64, from 20261025T1500-c17-review-fuelcell and 20261025T1547-c17-review-fuelring-slowd); Df 0.5 6/9 (2/3; 0.55/0.55); Df 0.2 13/12 (3/3; 0.81/0.76); outside-only Df 0.2 14/17 (3/4; 0.50/0.50); for reference Df 0.3 10/14 (3/4) and chi_s=0 at Df 2 10 on seed 12 (gen 2, fuel 0.35), from 20261025T1547-c17-review-fuelring-slowd. Uniformly slow fuel recovers the ring's division at Df 0.2 on these seeds (25 vs 26), more than on the finding's seeds. Sealing only the outside gives the most division at the lowest interior fuel of the three twins. Division tracks a sealed edge, not interior fuel, and a ringless, outside-only diffusion barrier does everything the ring does.

seeds_run.result: pass: Df 0.5 6 splits, Df 0.2 13 splits (ringed 16), outside-only 14
pass: Df 0.5 9 splits, Df 0.2 12 splits (ringed 10), outside-only 17

verdicts.limitation: Two seeds per arm, and split counts vary by +-40% between seeds, so the ordering outside-only > ring ~ Df 0.2 > Df 0.5 is suggestive, not established. The outside-only twin's step follows phi, so it moves with the interface, as the ring does; it is a smooth barrier, not a material one. The ringed-world numbers come from my earlier directories, not from re-runs here.
